open_points.subject: _revoke_viewer_sessions
open_points.text: - _revoke_viewer_sessions: [BEHAVIOR] MUST return every session newly revoked for viewer_id with the supplied revoked_at and leave already revoked sessions unchanged.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_viewer_session(self, session_id: UUID) -> ViewerSession | None
open_points.question: Must a viewer-id-based session listing operation be added, or must _revoke_viewer_sessions be changed so it receives session identities rather than viewer_id?

open_points.subject: describe_viewer_session
open_points.text: - describe_viewer_session: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST read the selected session through tx.viewer_access().get_viewer_session(actor.session_id), require that it still exists, belongs to actor.viewer_id, is unrevoked and unexpired at the one captured current time, and return ViewerSessionView(session_id, viewer_id, expires_at) only; any authentication outcome raises AuthenticationRejected and no token/hash is returned.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_viewer_session(self, session_id: UUID) -> ViewerSession | None
open_points.question: Must get_viewer_session be declared on ViewerAccessRepository as required by the note, or must the note permit the declared PortalTransaction.get_viewer_session operation?

open_points.subject: sign_out_viewer
open_points.text: - sign_out_viewer: [SECURITY_BOUNDARY] MUST load exactly actor.session_id through tx.viewer_access(), require the stored viewer_id to equal actor.viewer_id, replace only that session with revoked_at set from one current timestamp, persist it, commit once and return None. It MUST NOT expose or return the persisted ViewerSession, revoke every viewer session, accept a session id from request data, or treat an already revoked/missing/mismatched session as success; replay of the old cookie raises AuthenticationRejected.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def get_viewer_session(self, session_id: UUID) -> ViewerSession | None
open_points.question: Must get_viewer_session be declared on ViewerAccessRepository so the session can be loaded through tx.viewer_access(), or must the note allow the declared transaction-level operation?

open_points.subject: sign_out_viewer
open_points.text: - sign_out_viewer: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST close its one explicit transaction exactly once, rolling back on failure only while it is still open, and use only tx.viewer_access().get_viewer_session and update_viewer_sessions; failures before commit rollback once and re-raise unchanged.
open_points.other_text:
# PortalTransaction
def update_viewer_sessions(self, sessions: list[ViewerSession]) -> None
open_points.question: Must update_viewer_sessions be called on PortalTransaction as declared, or must it be declared on ViewerAccessRepository to match the viewer_access owner boundary?
